instructions: Wash the 2 apples and dry them well.
Cut each apple into quarters, cut out the core, and slice each quarter into slices about 1/4 inch thick.
Cut the lemon in half and squeeze it over the slices, turning them so each cut side gets a little juice. That keeps them from going brown.
Lay the slices out on a plate and spread the 1/3 cup peanut butter over them, a thin layer on each.
Scatter the 2 tbsp dried cranberries, 2 tbsp dried blueberries and 1 tsp sliced almonds over the peanut butter.
Serve them right away. If you're packing them to go, keep the peanut butter in a small container and slice the apple when you eat.
method_notes: Both versions slice a crisp apple and pair it with peanut butter. Everyday Eileen (the lead, since neither page has 20 ratings) is written for four: two large Gala or Fuji apples cut 1/4 inch thick, a squeeze of lemon, 1/3 cup peanut butter spread on the slices and a scatter of dried fruit and almonds. Fork in the Road serves 2 tbsp of peanut butter per apple on the side as a dip and says not to freeze the slices. This follows the lead as written.
